category: app hosting and shared seedbox (one-click apps)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial is published; the entry plan BG-2000 is EUR 8.74 per month, shown as EUR 6.12 per month for the first month with a 30% welcome discount.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: sold by total disk (2 TB HDD on BG-2000); no single-file cap is published

retention.stated: for the life of the subscription; no inactivity deletion is stated

egress.terms: BG-2000 lists 'Unmetered' traffic on a 10Gbps connection speed with 2 app slots.

interface_detail: The app catalogue lists 'File Browser & Webdav' and a FileZilla Client app; the plan page itself does not name a transfer protocol, so SFTP or FTP access is unverified.
tooling: Appbox dashboard with a 60+ app store (including File Browser with WebDAV, FileZilla Client and Rclone); streaming app categories are excluded on BG-2000; no API or CLI is documented
chaining: A EUR 8.74 2 TB unmetered 10 Gbps app box; an Rclone app (Rclone Web plus an SSH login that runs rclone commands only) copies between cloud remotes; a torrent client app was not shown in the app text read: unverified

limits.value: 10Gbps connection speed, unmetered traffic, 2 app slots

limits_note: Larger plans: 3 TB EUR 10.99, 3.5 TB EUR 13.95, 4.5 TB EUR 18.51, 6 TB EUR 24.60, 8 TB EUR 31.90, 12 TB EUR 43.99 a month before the welcome discount. Streaming, Stacks, CMS, Operating System, Webserver, VPS and Windows app categories are excluded on BG-2000.
binding_note: No quota or object cap is published; the 2 app slots and the excluded categories shape what runs on the entry plan.

identity_cost.detail: Orders go through billing.appbox.co with an account. Payment methods, phone and document requirements were not read: unverified.

reliability_note: Unmetered traffic with no fair-use numbers read; the app-slot count limits concurrent apps.
confidence_note: Plan, price and traffic are on the vendor home page read on 2026-11-03. A measured rung needs a slot and a timed transfer.
